annotations.title: Get a Google Calendar connection link

description: Get the link that connects the signed-in user's Google Calendar to TaskLite. Send connectUrl to the person as is: they open it, approve on Google's own page, and come back. It lasts 24 hours and can be opened again in that time; calling again makes a new one. Only that person can approve: the link connects whichever Google account approves it to THIS TaskLite user, so send it only to them. With appId the browser comes back to that app's site, on the domain the app has at that moment (its custom domain, else <slug>.tasklite.dev), at returnPath (a path such as "/#admin"), or at the path saved with google_calendar_set_return_path, else "/". Without appId it ends on a TaskLite page that says the calendar is connected. includeBusyRead true also asks to read busy time (the person's existing meetings) so bookings can avoid them; Google calls that a sensitive permission and shows a stronger consent screen, so ask for it only when the person wants it. Asking again later keeps the write access already given. Afterwards google_calendar_status shows connected.

appId.description: App id or slug whose site the browser returns to

includeBusyRead.description: Also ask to read busy time in the person's other calendars. Default false

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

returnPath.description: A path on the app's site starting with "/", e.g. "/#admin" or "/admin/calendar". Not an address: the domain is the app's

name: google_calendar_connect
